releases.highlight: First public build: Body / Mind / Spirit life progress, whole-life radar, and local-first sync.
notes: Whole-Life model: every activity declares how it affects Body, Mind and Spirit
GitHub-style contribution calendar with 5 intensity levels, not a binary done/undone
Variable targets per activity (reps, minutes, glasses, km, %, custom units)
Unlimited same-day reminders with days-of-week, start/end dates and snooze
Body / Mind / Spirit visualisations: muscle map, brain, and spirit aura
Life attribute radar derived from accumulated activity, with diminishing returns
Bad-habit quitting kept first-class: relapse is logged, never erases history
Local-first storage (IndexedDB) with sync to your own MonsterASP SQL Server
